blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — A month after the deadly shooting at Banga National High School in South Cotabato, the last of the three students who died in the incident was laid to rest on Saturday, Oct. 17, as grieving relatives renewed their call for justice. Angelito Perra, 14, who was shot in the back during the attack carried out by a fellow student, was buried at the Banga Public Cemetery following a funeral Mass held before noon. Hundreds of mourners, including relatives, friends, classmates, teachers, and officials from the Department of Education and the local government, joined the burial rites. […]...
